[quote=nordiheim;60561216]
[spoiler=Dealings in Kuhaw-Astan]
[b][u]The two lower islands[/u][/b]

With the local Argossian population having been evacuated to the last, and no more being spotted on the island, it was soon decided by the Nordiheimian command that there was little point in having any naval forces watching the islands or agents hiding on them, not that there was many left, as such the stealth corvettes that had been keeping an eye on them was recaled for other duties and the remaining agents withdrawn during the dark of the night.
All that would remain would be a stealth observation UAV, joust to see if they did anyting on the island at all.

[b][u]The UDF and Deasun attack on the Restorationists fortress island[/u][/b]

Because of Nordiheims monitoring and surveilance of the restorationists fortress island the attacks from Deasun would be known to Nordihiem, though they were a bit supriced that they had uped their involvement to balisitic missiles.
But noting would be done or comentet about this by Nordiheim other then observing the situation, they were curious about how effective it would end up being in the end.
The fact that the restonationists had little or no way of countering Deasun air and missile power did not realy come as a suprice, as they had allready recived the report of the secound fleet about how devestating their EW suit had been ageinst their ships ability to propperly target them.

The infiltrators on the island was told to try and stay away from likely targets however, to minimize the chance of them being killed in the attacks, and instead operate from outside of these areas and in the forests.

[b][u]The remaining forces from the two lower islands[/u][/b]

The training of the remaining 150 soldiers and their 1000 new companions in arms would proceed with great speed and progress, the force might have been small even with their new reinforcements but they did not lack in purpose and goal.
As such the Nordiheimian special forces from Aboria and Ostland would put them trough intense and propper training to ensure that they eventualy would be ready for the future, both for marine missions and special jungle/forest combat.

Though it was not a fully one sided endeavor, the Argossians from Astanir would have their own tricks and knowledge about doing jungel fighting that would actualy impress the Aborians, it would seem that their more primitive way of living had allowed them to preserve ancient and hard earned knowledge much bether then compared to what their more modern age brethren had been able to.
As such the Nordiheimians that trained them would also recive training from them in return wich would allow for a bether understanding about how they did tings, someting that would allow their training to be bether tailored to fit their way of tinking.

[b][u]The Kuhaw-Astan of mainland Astanir[/u][/b]

The strenghtening of the different parts of the Argossians military would continue forward both in the way of new equipment and how to use it propperly trough Nordiheims advisors and instructors, especialy when it came to the creation of the Kuhaw-Astan air force that they sett up a make shift school for since so few of them had realy interacted with aircraft.
While they could not find anyone with prior experience for quick learning they did find some that had promisse when it came to physical and mental ability, these induvituals would be given a propper and deep education in the field of being a airforce pilot both trough teoretical teaching and practical leasons trough the use of 10 KJ-5H Cockatoo fighters that had been modefied as specialized training aircraft.

The new SAM sites would also be furter improved, with a few AMHAML-34/37 Modules mounted on Karlson 95MPT trucks, and some bether radar and targeting systems being given them to make up for their existing, and not very modern, equipment and instalations.
The crew that the Argossians had to use these systems would be given carefully prepared information and help to be able to identify what was a Nordiheimian aircraft and what wasen't so that there wouldn't be any accidents as they gained the ability to bether see what was in the air compared to before.

There would also be given a bunch of older drones to them, these ranged from surveilance type drones to what was basicly a small flying bomb, while the Argossians tribesmen would not necesearly now how to fully utilize them at this time they would be given training and instructions to be able to use them in the future.

[u]The Kuhaw-Astan push south[/u]

To aid the Argossians in their attacks south the Nordiheimians would give them active and running information about all hostile forces, battle lines and bases that the isolationists and the restorationist pocked had, all they way from they southern part of the main Kuhaw-Astan pocket and over to the Sui-mana enclave, this would allow them to strick more effectivly and with less losses.
It would also be pointed out the best strategies for were and how to use the heavier armored vehicles that they had been given, especialy since it didn't seem like at this point that their enemies at this point had a good and effective counter to such vehicles, though keeping them covered with AA was still adviced since there was no telling what they might try out of desperation or innovating ideas.

[u]An unexpected event[/u]

Someting that the Nordiheimian command did not expect was the sudden decision of some Nordiheimian merchenaries, especialy those of heavy Aboriginal decent, to take their stuff and travel over to the Kuhaw-Astan and offer their services to them in apperently a show of brotherly support trough their ancient blood relations.
While they had kept an eye on the 12'000+ that they had gathered in ostland for a potential "expeditionary force", a plan that had eventualy been shelfed, as they had rather strongly voiced the opinion that they sould go ahead with this plan.
They had not fully expected other merchenary groups to send people there on their own with little or no monetary gain or proffit in sight.

As such some would find their way over there before Nordiheim could put a stop to it and talk to the merc groups in question, they would agree to not send any more over but could not get the ones that had allready left to come back, they were Nordiheimian merchenaries after all and as such followed their hearths about such things, so no amount of ordering them back would realy work anyway.

Only a couple of thousand would end up going to the Kuhaw-Astan though, less then half compared to the original "expeditionary force", so it was not expected that they would achive anyting big in the grand scheme of tings, they had apperently also left behind any markings and identification that could tie them to Nordiheim making them effectivly joust passionate Argossian volunteers, someting that the Nordiheimian military felt relieved about.

[b][u]The meeting between the Kuhaw-Astan and the "Democratic" faction[/u][/b]

The Nordiheimians would aid the Kuhaw-Astan in several matters spoken off in this meeting, be it wordings, translations or what they and how they should present and lay forth their demands or requirements, aswell as what part of the Astanir mainland island was to be considered part of their land.
They would also sett themself as the guarantier of the Kuhaw-Astan to make sure that what they had been promissed would be upheld by the Qianxun controlled "Democrats".

Though how far and how tightly the Kuhaw-Astan would be willing to go with these deals would be entierly up to them, they were their own people and Nordiheim had never had the intention to controll them further then support and advice them in their fight for a bether future, the Argossians of Astanir would have the final say in the matters that would decide their fate.
[/spoiler]
[/quote]

[spoiler=[b]Kuhaw-Astan[/b]]
[b][u]Training of the survivors[/u][/b]
The training given to them by Nordiheim would form them into essentially a specialised guerilla unit. They would take orders from both Nordiheim and Kuhaw-Astan, making themselves and their skills avaliable wherever possible to help their ethnic brothers.

[b][u]Kuhaw-Astan on the mainland[/u][/b]
The training given by Nordiheim would slowly but surely begin to build up an independent, functioning air force for the argossians, further securing their future as an independent entity.

The SAMs would also be put to good use, allowing for security in Kuhaw-Astan's airspace. The drones would be tested, before being put to work as surveillance devices, surveying the stale frontline with the restorationists in preparation for an offensive.

[u]The push south[/u]
The advice and intelligence given by Nordiheim would all be used in Kuhaw-Astan's "Operation Pana Hema" into the southern restorationist exclave. The operation would begin by entering the territory in Nordiheimian-provided armoured vehicles and tanks. Upon facing resistance, the argossians would cover themselves with AA and machine gun fire, as well as short-range surface-to-surface missiles. Progress would be rapid, with the advanced Nordiheimian equipment helping the argossians to tear through the lines of the always weakening restorationists. Within two days, the argossians had taken most of the territory, including the major settlement of Uu-Luok.

[u]The unexpected mercenaries[/u]
The mercenaries, upon arriving in Kuhaw-Astan would be greeted and then swiftly integrated partially into the argossian army, forming their own specialised units which could be deployed by Kuhaw-Astan. Half of them would be deployed onto the frontlines of "Operation Pana Hema", whilst the other half would stay and defend the core territories of Kuhaw-Astan.

[b][u]The meeting[/u][/b]
With Nordiheimian support, the deal would go ahead, securing a strong partnership between the argossians and the democrats, as well as the possibilty of a two-state solution, which had up until now been total speculation from the argossians.

[/spoiler]
